commit.message:
Add an implementation status entry for wimsey (#296)

* Add an implementation status entry for wimsey

wimsey is a vendor-neutral Rust implementation of the WIMSE drafts,
covering the WIT, the WPT, the HTTP Signature binding and the mTLS
binding. Yaron invited an entry on the working group list.

Entries go into the two documents that already have an Implementation
Status section. The WPT and mutual-TLS documents have no such section;
happy to add one to each if the editors want it, since wimsey implements
both.

* Match the house style for implementation status entries

The entry was several times longer than every existing one, used a
Notes field no other entry has, and in workload-creds carried fields
that file does not use.

Let the requestor require response signing via an integrity-protected
signature parameter, with clear rules when the server cannot sign (#277).
